settings.menu.description: The name of the settings menu, the navigation of the settings pages in groups (the screen at /settings, and the column beside a settings page on wide screens), for assistive technology.

settings.back.description: The button at the top of a settings page that goes back to the settings menu, where the menu does not stand beside the page. A page under an entry (one keyword filter) goes back to its entry instead, by the entry's name (settings.entry.*).

settings.group.general.description: A group heading of the settings menu, over the entries Profile, Display and posting, and Notifications.

settings.group.people.description: A group heading of the settings menu, over the entries Relationships (blocked and muted accounts, muted servers, followed hashtags) and Keyword filters.

settings.group.access.description: A group heading of the settings menu, over the entries Security, Apps, and Invites: how the reader signs in, and what and who else gets in.

settings.group.account.description: A group heading of the settings menu, over the entry Account and data.

settings.entry.profile.description: An entry of the settings menu, and the title of its page, where the reader edits their profile.

settings.entry.profile.hint.defaultMessage: 名前、自己紹介、画像、バッジ、フォロワーの承認、検索への表示
settings.entry.profile.hint.description: The line under Profile in the settings menu at /settings: what its page holds, so that the reader finds a setting without opening every entry. A list of nouns, without a full stop.

settings.entry.display.description: An entry of the settings menu, and the title of its page: the language, the time zone, how the app shows things, and what a new post starts with.

settings.entry.display.hint.defaultMessage: 言語、タイムゾーン、リンクのプレビュー、新しい投稿の初期値、タイムラインの言語
settings.entry.display.hint.description: The line under Display and posting in the settings menu at /settings: what its page holds. A list of nouns, without a full stop.

settings.entry.notifications.description: An entry of the settings menu, and the title of its page, where the reader chooses what notifies them and how.

settings.entry.notifications.hint.defaultMessage: 通知する内容、プッシュ通知、メール、通知音、知らない人からの通知
settings.entry.notifications.hint.description: The line under Notifications in the settings menu at /settings: what its page holds (the kinds of notification and the ways each arrives, and what happens to notifications from people the reader does not know). A list of nouns, without a full stop.

settings.entry.relationships.description: An entry of the settings menu, and the title of its page, which lists the accounts the reader blocked or muted, the servers they muted, and the hashtags they follow.

settings.entry.relationships.hint.defaultMessage: ブロックしたアカウント、ミュートしたアカウント、ミュートしたサーバー、フォロー中のハッシュタグ
settings.entry.relationships.hint.description: The line under Relationships in the settings menu at /settings: the lists its page holds. A list of nouns, without a full stop.

settings.entry.filters.description: An entry of the settings menu, and the title of its page, which lists the reader's keyword filters; also the button at the top of one filter's page that goes back to the list.

settings.entry.filters.hint.defaultMessage: 投稿を畳むか隠す言葉やフレーズ
settings.entry.filters.hint.description: The line under Keyword filters in the settings menu at /settings: what a keyword filter is (posts with its words are folded behind the filter's name, or left out). Without a full stop.

settings.entry.security.description: An entry of the settings menu, and the title of its page: how the reader signs in and where they are signed in; also the button at the top of a page under it (the password, two-factor authentication) that goes back to it.

settings.entry.security.hint.defaultMessage: パスワード、パスキー、二要素認証、連携したアカウント、ログイン中のブラウザ
settings.entry.security.hint.description: The line under Security in the settings menu at /settings: what its page holds. Linked accounts are the reader's accounts on other services that they sign in with. A list of nouns, without a full stop.

settings.entry.apps.description: An entry of the settings menu, and the title of its page: the apps of other makers that the reader let use their account, and the apps the reader registered as their developer.

settings.entry.apps.hint.defaultMessage: アカウントの利用を許可したアプリ、自分で登録したアプリ
settings.entry.apps.hint.description: The line under Apps in the settings menu at /settings: the two lists its page holds. A list of nouns, without a full stop.

settings.entry.invites.description: An entry of the settings menu, and the title of its page, where the reader makes invites (a code, and a link with the code) that let people create an account on this server.

settings.entry.invites.hint.defaultMessage: このサーバーに人を招待するコードとリンク
settings.entry.invites.hint.description: The line under Invites in the settings menu at /settings: what its page holds. Without a full stop.

settings.entry.account.description: An entry of the settings menu, and the title of its page: the reader's data, and what becomes of the account; also the button at the top of a page under it that goes back to it.

settings.entry.account.hint.defaultMessage: エクスポートとインポート、古い投稿の自動削除、アカウントの移転、モデレーションの処分と異議申し立て、無効化と削除
settings.entry.account.hint.description: The line under Account and data in the settings menu at /settings: what its page holds (export and import of the reader's data, deleting their old posts automatically, moving the account to another server, the moderators' actions on the account and the reader's appeals, deactivating or deleting the account). A list of nouns, without a full stop.

settings.entry.count.defaultMessage: {count, plural, other {確認が必要な項目 # 件}}
settings.entry.count.description: What the count at the end of an entry of the settings menu means, for assistive technology, read after the entry's name: how many things on its page wait for the reader (a moderation action to read, an export ready to download). count is that number, 1 or more.

settings.entry.voice.description: An entry of the settings menu, and the title of its page, which lists the voice chat rooms the reader hosted.

settings.entry.voice.hint.description: The line under Voice chat in the settings menu.

settings.entry.events.description: The entry of the settings of events (the reminders before them), in the settings' menu and as its screen's title.

settings.entry.events.hint.defaultMessage: イベントの前のリマインダー
settings.entry.events.hint.description: The line under the entry of the settings of events in the settings' menu.

settings.sign_out.description: The last row of the settings menu, apart from its groups: it signs this browser out, after a confirmation (settings.sign_out.title).

settings.sign_out.title.defaultMessage: このブラウザからログアウトしますか？
settings.sign_out.title.description: The question of the confirmation before the app signs the reader out of the browser they are using.

settings.sign_out.text.defaultMessage: ほかのブラウザやアプリはログインしたままです。書きかけの投稿と、オフラインで読むために保存したホームタイムラインは、このブラウザから削除されます。保存した下書きは残ります。
settings.sign_out.text.description: What signing out does, under the confirmation's question: only this browser is signed out; what the app kept in this browser alone is removed (a post being written and not saved as a draft, the newest posts of the home timeline kept for reading offline); the drafts saved on the server (compose.drafts.save) stay.

settings.sign_out.confirm.description: The button of the confirmation that signs this browser out.

settings.sign_out.cancel.description: The refusal of the confirmation of signing out: the reader stays signed in.

settings.sign_out.failed.defaultMessage: ログアウトを完了できませんでした。このブラウザはログインしたままの可能性があります。もう一度試してください。
settings.sign_out.failed.description: In the confirmation of signing out, which stays open, when the sign-out got no answer from the server (the network, the server): the reader presses the confirmation's button again.

settings.not_found.defaultMessage: この設定のページはありません。アドレスを確かめてください。
settings.not_found.description: In place of a settings page at an address under /settings that names none (/settings/nothing), the only thing the screen says of it: the screen's heading and the document's title stay Settings (app.settings). The link to the settings menu follows it on the same line (settings.not_found.all), so the sentence does not name the menu.

settings.not_found.all.description: The link right after settings.not_found, on the same line, that opens the settings menu at /settings; the words of the link after a missing announcement (announcements.all).

settings.loading.defaultMessage: 設定を読み込んでいます…
settings.loading.description: In place of the sections of a settings page while what it shows is being read from the server.

settings.failed.defaultMessage: 設定を読み込めませんでした。
settings.failed.description: In place of the sections of a settings page when what it shows could not be read from the server (the network, the server); Try again follows it on the same line (settings.retry).

settings.retry.description: The button after settings.failed that reads the settings from the server again.

settings.unsaved.defaultMessage: 「{setting}」を保存できませんでした。設定を開いて、もう一度変更してください。
settings.unsaved.description: A toast at the bottom of the screen, when a change of a setting was not saved (the network, the server, or a value the server refused) and the reader had already left the settings page, so that the row of the setting cannot say it: the setting went back to what it was. setting is the setting's name as its row shows it (Show new posts as they arrive). Its button opens the page of that setting (settings.unsaved.open).

settings.unsaved.open.description: The button of the toast settings.unsaved: it opens the settings page that holds the setting which was not saved.

settings.unsaved.close.description: The name of the close button of the toast settings.unsaved, for assistive technology: it puts the toast away.

settings.display.section.region.description: The heading of the first section of the Display and posting page of the settings, over the display language and the time zone.

settings.display.section.display.description: The heading of the section of the Display and posting page of the settings about how the app shows things (the size of link previews).

settings.display.section.posts.description: The heading of the section of the Display and posting page of the settings about what the composer starts a new post with.

settings.display.section.posts.about.defaultMessage: 新しい投稿は、ここで選んだ見られる人・言語で書きはじめます。投稿ごとに変えられます。
settings.display.section.posts.about.description: The line under the heading New posts: the first two choices of the section (Who can see it, Post language) are only where a post starts; the composer changes them for one post. It leaves out the third, requiring a description of media. Who can reply, boost and quote has a section of its own (settings.display.section.interactions).

settings.display.section.interactions.defaultMessage: 返信・ブースト・引用できる人
settings.display.section.interactions.description: The heading of the section of the Display and posting page of the settings about who may reply to, boost and quote the account's new posts by default; the composer's words for it (compose.permissions). Its three choices are Who can reply, Who can boost and Who can quote (settings.display.reply, settings.display.boost, settings.display.quote).

settings.display.section.interactions.ab.defaultMessage: 新しい投稿は、ここで選んだ設定で書きはじめます。投稿ごとに変えられます。
settings.display.section.interactions.ab.description: The line under the heading Who can reply, boost and quote on the Display and posting page of the settings: the three choices of the section are only where a post starts; the composer changes them for one post (compose.permissions).

settings.display.section.timelines.description: The heading of the section of the Display and posting page of the settings about what the timelines show.

settings.display.language.description: The label of the choice of the language the app is shown in, on the Display and posting page of the settings: first Same as the browser (settings.display.browser), then the languages the app has, each by its own name.

settings.display.language.about.defaultMessage: 届くメールやプッシュ通知にも使います。
settings.display.language.about.description: The line under Display language: the server writes the emails and push notifications it sends the reader in this language too.

settings.display.browser.description: The first option of the display language and of the time zone on the Display and posting page of the settings: the app follows the language, or the time zone, that the browser is set to, on each device.

settings.display.time_zone.description: The label of the choice of the time zone the app shows dates and times in, on the Display and posting page of the settings: first Same as the browser (settings.display.browser), then the time zones.

settings.display.time_zone.region.defaultMessage: {region, select, Africa {アフリカ} America {南北アメリカ} Antarctica {南極} Arctic {北極} Asia {アジア} Atlantic {大西洋} Australia {オーストラリア} Europe {ヨーロッパ} Indian {インド洋} Pacific {太平洋} other {その他}}
settings.display.time_zone.region.description: The name of a group of time zones in the choice of the time zone, on the Display and posting page of the settings: the part of the world its places are in. region is the first part of the zones' names in the time zone database (Asia of Asia/Tokyo); the three oceans are named as oceans (Atlantic Ocean, Indian Ocean, Pacific Ocean). The choice offers no zone of another part, so other shows nowhere today; the format needs the branch.

settings.display.time_zone.option.description: A time zone in the choice of the time zone, under the name of its part of the world (settings.display.time_zone.region). place is the zone's place as the time zone database names it, in English (Tokyo, Buenos Aires); offset is how far its clocks are from UTC now, as the reader's language writes it (GMT+9).

settings.display.link_cards.defaultMessage: 投稿のリンクのプレビュー
settings.display.link_cards.description: The label of the choice of how large the card of a link in a post is (the page's picture, title and description), on the Display and posting page of the settings: Large or Small.

settings.display.link_cards.large.description: An option of Link previews in posts: the card has the page's picture above its text.

settings.display.link_cards.small.description: An option of Link previews in posts: the card has a small square picture beside its text.

settings.display.audience.description: The label of the choice of the visibility a new post starts with, in the New posts section of the Display and posting page of the settings; the composer's words for it (compose.audience). Its options are the composer's visibilities (compose.visibility.*).

settings.display.reply.description: The label of the choice of who may reply to a new post unless the reader changes it in the post, in the section Who can reply, boost and quote of the Display and posting page of the settings; the composer's words for it (compose.interaction.reply). Its options are the composer's audiences, each alone or with others by the author's approval, as the composer writes a choice (compose.permission.now).

settings.display.boost.description: The label of the choice of who may boost a new post unless the reader changes it in the post, in the section Who can reply, boost and quote of the Display and posting page of the settings; the composer's words for it (compose.interaction.announce). Its options are the composer's audiences, each alone or with others by the author's approval, as the composer writes a choice (compose.permission.now).

settings.display.quote.description: The label of the choice of who may quote a new post unless the reader changes it in the post, in the section Who can reply, boost and quote of the Display and posting page of the settings; the composer's words for it (compose.interaction.quote). Its options are the composer's audiences, each alone or with others by the author's approval, as the composer writes a choice (compose.permission.now).

settings.display.post_language.description: The label of the choice of the language a new post is marked as written in unless the reader changes it in the post, in the New posts section of the Display and posting page of the settings: first Same as the display language (settings.display.post_language.display), then languages, each by its own name.

settings.display.post_language.display.description: The first option of Post language: a new post starts in the language the app is shown in (settings.display.language).

settings.display.media_description.defaultMessage: メディアの説明を必須にする
settings.display.media_description.description: The label of a switch in the New posts section of the Display and posting page of the settings: on, the composer does not post an image, a video or audio that has no description (alt text) until the reader adds one. Short, to stay on one line on a phone; the line under it says the rest (settings.display.media_description.about).

settings.display.media_description.about.defaultMessage: オンにすると、説明 (代替テキスト) のないメディアは投稿できません。
settings.display.media_description.about.description: The line under Require media descriptions: what the switch does when on. Media is an image, a video or audio attached to a post; the description is the composer's (compose.description). While the server itself requires descriptions, settings.display.media_description.server stands in its place.

settings.display.media_description.serve.defaultMessage: このサーバーでは、すべてのメディアに説明が必要なため、常にオンです。
settings.display.media_description.serve.description: The line under Require media descriptions, in place of settings.display.media_description.about, while the server requires a description of every media file (the instance's limit require_media_description): the switch shows on and cannot be changed, and this says why.

settings.display.timeline_languages.description: The label of the choice of the languages whose posts the timelines show (several may be chosen), in the Timelines section of the Display and posting page of the settings.

settings.display.timeline_languages.abou.defaultMessage: 言語を選ぶと、ほかの言語の投稿は、どのタイムラインにも表示しません。言語が設定されていない投稿は表示します。
settings.display.timeline_languages.abou.description: The line under Languages to show, the same while no language is chosen (the choice says All languages, and nothing is left out) and once some are: with languages chosen, the home, list, local, federated and hashtag timelines leave out the posts marked as written in another language, and keep the posts marked with none.

settings.display.timeline_languages.all.description: What the choice of Languages to show says while no language is chosen: the timelines show posts in every language.

settings.display.timeline_languages.add.description: What the choice of Languages to show says once a language is chosen, in place of All languages (settings.display.timeline_languages.all): choosing a language there adds it to the list under it.

settings.display.timeline_languages.remo.description: The button at the end of a language in the list under Languages to show: it takes the language out of the list, and the timelines stop showing posts in that language alone; once the list is empty they show every language again. The word of the other buttons that take one thing out of a set (compose.remove, timeline.list_remove).

The name of the Remove button of a language in the list under Languages to show, for assistive technology; it holds the button's visible word (settings.display.timeline_languages.remove). language is the language's own name (日本語).

settings.display.auto_insert.defaultMessage: 新しい投稿が届いたらすぐに表示する
settings.display.auto_insert.description: The label of a switch in the Timelines section of the Display and posting page of the settings: on, a new post goes into the home timeline and the list timelines by itself; off, new posts wait until the reader presses the button over the timeline that counts them (timeline.new_posts).

settings.display.auto_insert.about.defaultMessage: オフにすると、タイムラインの上の「新しい投稿」のボタンを押すまで表示しません。
settings.display.auto_insert.about.description: The line under Show new posts as they arrive: what happens when the switch is off. The quoted words are those of the button over a timeline (timeline.new_posts: 3 new posts).

settings.profile.section.you.defaultMessage: あなたのプロフィール
settings.profile.section.you.description: A section heading of the Profile page of the settings, over the reader's own avatar, name and handle as others see them with the button Edit profile, the hashtags they feature, and the switch that marks the account as a bot.

settings.profile.section.badges.description: A section heading of the Profile page of the settings, over one switch for each badge the reader may show on their profile. The section is absent for a reader with no badge.

settings.profile.section.badges.about.defaultMessage: このサーバーから付与されたバッジです。オンにしたバッジは、プロフィールのハンドルの横に表示されます。
settings.profile.section.badges.about.description: The line under the Badges heading of the Profile page of the settings. A badge is a short name the server's administrators attach to some accounts (Moderator, Supporter); each is hidden until its owner shows it.

settings.profile.section.follows.defaultMessage: フォローとフォロワー
settings.profile.section.follows.description: A section heading of the Profile page of the settings, over the switch that makes follows need the reader's approval and the choice of who sees the lists of whom they follow and who follows them.

settings.profile.section.discovery.defaultMessage: アカウントの見つかり方
settings.profile.section.discovery.description: A section heading of the Profile page of the settings, over the switches that decide where the account and its public posts appear: suggestions and the search by name, search engines and this server's search of posts, AI, and the Atom feed.

settings.profile.edit.description: The button that opens the form where the reader changes their profile (pictures, display name, bio, fields): beside the reader's name on the Profile page of the settings, and at the top of the reader's own profile. Also the title of that form's page.

settings.profile.hashtags.description: The label of the field of the hashtags the reader features on their profile, on the Profile page of the settings; the profile's own words for them (profile.featured). A hashtag typed there is added at once.

settings.profile.hashtags.about.defaultMessage: {max, number} 個まで追加できます。プロフィールに表示されます。
settings.profile.hashtags.about.description: The line under Featured hashtags on the Profile page of the settings. max is the most hashtags an account may feature (10).

settings.profile.hashtags.placeholder.description: The placeholder of the field of featured hashtags while it takes another one; the same words as the hashtags of an article (compose.article.tags.placeholder).

settings.profile.hashtags.full.defaultMessage: これ以上は追加できません
settings.profile.hashtags.full.description: The placeholder of the field of featured hashtags once it holds the most an account may feature, so that it takes no more.

settings.profile.hashtags.remove.description: The name of the button on a featured hashtag that removes it from the reader's profile, for assistive technology. tag is the hashtag without its #.

settings.profile.bot.defaultMessage: ボットのアカウントとして表示する
settings.profile.bot.description: The label of a switch on the Profile page of the settings: on, the account says it is automated, and the profile shows the mark Bot (profile.bot) beside its name.

settings.profile.bot.about.defaultMessage: プログラムが投稿するアカウント向けです。名前の横に「ボット」と表示されます。
settings.profile.bot.about.description: The line under Mark this account as a bot. The quoted word is the mark on the profile (profile.bot).

settings.profile.badge.description: The label of the switch that shows one badge on the reader's profile, or hides it. label is the name on the badge, written by the server's administrators (Moderator).

settings.profile.locked.defaultMessage: フォローを承認制にする
settings.profile.locked.description: The label of a switch on the Profile page of the settings: on, someone who wants to follow the reader sends a request, which the reader approves or declines; the profile then says Follow requests need approval (profile.locked).

settings.profile.locked.about.defaultMessage: フォローはリクエストとして届き、それぞれ承認するか断ります。オフにしても、すでに届いているリクエストは承認されません。
settings.profile.locked.about.description: The line under Require approval to follow you: what the switch does, and that the requests waiting when it is turned off stay until the reader answers them.

settings.profile.follows_visibility.defaultMessage: フォローとフォロワーの一覧を見られる人
settings.profile.follows_visibility.description: The label of the choice of who may open the lists of the accounts the reader follows and of their followers, on the Profile page of the settings. Its options are settings.profile.follows_visibility.option.

settings.profile.follows_visibility.abou.defaultMessage: 人数は誰でも見られます。
settings.profile.follows_visibility.abou.description: The line under Who can see your following and followers lists: how many accounts the reader follows and how many follow them shows on the profile whatever is chosen.

settings.profile.follows_visibility.opti.defaultMessage: {who, select, public {誰でも} followers {フォロワー} other {自分だけ}}
settings.profile.follows_visibility.opti.description: An option of Who can see your following and followers lists; the composer's words for the same audiences (compose.audience.everyone, compose.audience.followers, compose.audience.nobody). who is public, followers or private.

settings.profile.discoverable.defaultMessage: おすすめと名前の検索に表示する
settings.profile.discoverable.description: The label of a switch on the Profile page of the settings: on, the account is suggested to other people and the search of accounts finds it by a part of its name.

settings.profile.discoverable.about.defaultMessage: オフにすると、ユーザー名が完全に一致したときだけ検索で見つかります。
settings.profile.discoverable.about.description: The line under Appear in suggestions and in search by name: what happens when the switch is off.

settings.profile.indexable.defaultMessage: プロフィールと公開投稿を検索に載せる
settings.profile.indexable.description: The label of a switch on the Profile page of the settings: on, search engines and this server's search of posts may show the reader's profile and public posts.

settings.profile.indexable.about.defaultMessage: {where, select, both {検索エンジンと、このサーバーの投稿の検索に表示されることがあります。} engines {検索エンジンに表示されることがあります。} elsewhere {このサーバーは、すべてのアカウントで検索エンジンへの掲載を断っています。この選択はほかのサーバーにも送られ、そのサーバーの検索で使われることがあります。} other {このサーバーは、すべてのアカウントで検索エンジンへの掲載を断っています。このサーバーの投稿の検索に載せるかどうかは、この選択で決まります。}}
settings.profile.indexable.about.description: The line under Include your profile and public posts in search: where the choice applies. where is both on a server that lets search engines in and has a search of posts, engines on one that lets search engines in and has no search of posts, server on one that tells search engines not to list any account and has a search of posts, where the choice applies to that search, and elsewhere on one that tells search engines not to list any account and has no search of posts: the choice then decides nothing on this server, but other servers receive it with the profile and may use it for their own search.

settings.profile.ai_opt_out.defaultMessage: AI の学習と利用を拒否する
settings.profile.ai_opt_out.description: The label of a switch on the Profile page of the settings: on, the reader's pages on this server state that AI may neither train on them nor use them (in AI search, assistants and agents).

settings.profile.ai_opt_out.about.defaultMessage: {server, select, deny_training {このサーバーは、すべてのアカウントで AI の学習を拒否しています。オンにすると、このサーバーのあなたのページは、AI の検索やアシスタントでの利用も拒否します。ほかのサーバーとメディアのファイルには反映されません。} other {オンにすると、このサーバーのあなたのページが、AI のクローラーに学習と利用の拒否を伝えます。ほかのサーバーとメディアのファイルには反映されません。}}
settings.profile.ai_opt_out.about.description: The line under Refuse AI training and use: what the switch does and where it stops (the copies of the reader's posts on other servers, and the media files, do not carry the statement). server is what the server itself states for every account: deny_training when it already refuses training and lets AI use the pages, anything else when it allows both.

settings.profile.ai_opt_out.overridden.defaultMessage: このサーバーは、すべてのアカウントで AI の学習と利用を拒否しているため、この選択は反映されません。
settings.profile.ai_opt_out.overridden.description: The line under Refuse AI training and use while the switch is disabled and shows on: the server's administrators refuse both for every account, so both are refused whatever the reader chose.

settings.profile.feed.defaultMessage: 公開投稿の Atom フィードを出す
settings.profile.feed.description: The label of a switch on the Profile page of the settings: on, the reader's public posts can be read in a feed reader, from an Atom feed at the profile's address. Atom is the name of the feed format.

settings.profile.feed.about.defaultMessage: {follows, select, yes {アカウントのない人も、フィードリーダーで公開投稿を読めます。ここで選ぶまでは、上の検索の設定に合わせて切り替わります。} other {アカウントのない人も、フィードリーダーで公開投稿を読めます。}}
settings.profile.feed.about.description: The line under Offer an Atom feed of your public posts. follows is yes while the reader has never set this switch: it then turns on and off with the switch above it, Include your profile and public posts in search; once the reader sets it, it keeps their choice.

settings.profile.edit.section.pictures.description: A section heading of the Edit profile page of the settings, over the header image and the avatar.

settings.profile.edit.section.text.description: A section heading of the Edit profile page of the settings, over the display name and the bio.

settings.profile.header.description: The label of the picture across the top of the reader's profile, on the Edit profile page of the settings.

settings.profile.avatar.description: The label of the reader's avatar, the round picture beside their name, on the Edit profile page of the settings.

settings.profile.picture.choose.description: The button of the header image and of the avatar that opens the device's file picker, while there is no picture.

settings.profile.picture.replace.description: The button of the header image and of the avatar that opens the device's file picker to choose another picture in place of the one shown.

settings.profile.picture.remove.description: The button of the header image and of the avatar that removes the picture shown; the profile then shows none once the form is saved.

settings.profile.picture.failed.defaultMessage: {reason, select, processing {サーバーがこの画像を処理できませんでした。別の画像を選んでください。} other {この画像をアップロードできませんでした。もう一度保存するか、別の画像を選んでください。}}
settings.profile.picture.failed.description: Under the avatar or the header image on the Edit profile page when saving failed because of that picture and the server gave no words of its own. reason is processing when the server took the file and then could not turn it into a picture it can show, anything else when the upload did not get through.

settings.profile.name.description: The label of the field of the name the reader's account shows, on the Edit profile page of the settings.

settings.profile.name.over.defaultMessage: 表示名は {max, number} 文字以内にしてください。
settings.profile.name.over.description: Under the display name when it is longer than the limit.

settings.profile.name.rule.defaultMessage: 表示名は 1 行で {max, number} 文字以内にしてください。タブなどの制御文字は使えません。
settings.profile.name.rule.description: Under the display name, on the Edit profile page and on the welcome step of a new account, when the server refused it: the rule a display name follows, since the server says only that the value is not valid. max is 30.

settings.profile.note.description: The label of the field of the text about the reader that their profile shows under their name, on the Edit profile page of the settings.

settings.profile.note.over.defaultMessage: 自己紹介は {max, number} 文字以内にしてください。
settings.profile.note.over.description: Under the bio when it is longer than the limit.

settings.profile.count.left.description: What the count beside the display name or the bio says to a screen reader near the field's limit: how many characters are left.

settings.profile.count.over.description: What the count beside the display name or the bio says to a screen reader past the field's limit: by how many characters it is over.

settings.profile.fields.description: A section heading of the Edit profile page of the settings, and the name of the list under it: the short pairs of a label and its content that a profile shows under the bio (Website: https://example.org).

settings.profile.fields.about.defaultMessage: ラベルと内容の組を {max, number} 個まで追加できます (Web サイト、呼び方など)。プロフィールに表示され、URL はリンクになります。
settings.profile.fields.about.description: The line under the Fields heading of the Edit profile page. max is the most fields a profile has (4).

settings.profile.fields.empty.defaultMessage: 補足情報はまだありません。追加すると、Web サイトや呼び方などをプロフィールに表示できます。
settings.profile.fields.empty.description: In the place of the list of fields on the Edit profile page while the profile has none, over the button Add a field.

settings.profile.fields.add.description: The button that adds an empty field (a label and its content) to the list on the Edit profile page.

settings.profile.fields.name.description: The name and placeholder of the first box of a field on the Edit profile page: the short name of the field (Website).

settings.profile.fields.value.description: The name and placeholder of the second box of a field on the Edit profile page: what the profile shows under the label (https://example.org).

settings.profile.fields.legend.description: The name of one field of the list on the Edit profile page, for assistive technology, so that its two boxes are told from those of the next field. n is its place in the list, from 1.

settings.profile.fields.remove.defaultMessage: 補足情報 {n, number} を外す
settings.profile.fields.remove.description: The name of the button that removes one field from the list on the Edit profile page, for assistive technology. n is the field's place in the list, from 1.

settings.profile.save.description: The button at the bottom of the Edit profile page that saves every change of the form at once.

settings.profile.save.failed.defaultMessage: プロフィールを保存できませんでした。もう一度試してください。
settings.profile.save.failed.description: Beside the Save button of the Edit profile page when saving failed and the server gave no reason (no connection).

settings.profile.save.picture_failed.defaultMessage: 画像を使えなかったため、プロフィールは保存されませんでした。画像の下の説明を確認してください。
settings.profile.save.picture_failed.description: Beside the Save button of the Edit profile page when the avatar or the header image the reader picked could not be uploaded or was refused; what is wrong stands under that picture (settings.profile.picture.failed, or the server's own words).

settings.profile.leave.title.defaultMessage: 保存せずに移動しますか？
settings.profile.leave.title.description: The question of the confirmation that opens when the reader leaves the Edit profile page with changes they have not saved.

settings.profile.leave.text.defaultMessage: 保存していない変更は失われます。取り消せません。
settings.profile.leave.text.description: The text of the confirmation that asks whether to leave the Edit profile page without saving.

settings.profile.leave.confirm.description: The button of the confirmation that leaves the Edit profile page and drops the changes not saved.

settings.profile.leave.cancel.description: The button of the confirmation that stays on the Edit profile page, with the changes as the reader left them.

settings.notifications.section.device.description: A section heading of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications), over what is kept on the device the reader is using and not on their account: whether it gets push notifications, and whether it plays the notification sound.

settings.notifications.section.ordinary.description: A section heading of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications), and the name of its table: the kinds of notification that come from what other people do (mentions, follows, boosts).

settings.notifications.section.ordinary..defaultMessage: 通知の種類ごとに、届け方を選びます。「アプリ内」をオフにした種類の通知は作られないので、ほかの方法でも届きません。
settings.notifications.section.ordinary..description: The line under the heading From other people of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications), over the first table of kinds by channel. In the app is the column settings.notifications.channel.in_app.

settings.notifications.section.moderator.description: A section heading of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications), and the name of its table: the kinds of notification sent to the server's moderators and administrators (a new report, a sign-up to approve). Shown only to them.

settings.notifications.section.instance.description: A section heading of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications), and the name of its table: the kinds of notification the server itself sends the reader (the moderators' notices, announcements, its closure).

settings.notifications.push.description: The switch, in the section This device of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications), that turns Web Push on or off for the device the reader is using. The line under it is notifications.push_offer.

settings.notifications.push.no_server.defaultMessage: このサーバーはプッシュ通知を送りません。
settings.notifications.push.no_server.description: Why the Push notifications switch of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications) is off and cannot be turned on: the server is not set up to send Web Push.

settings.notifications.push.no_browser.defaultMessage: このブラウザはプッシュ通知を受け取れません。
settings.notifications.push.no_browser.description: Why the Push notifications switch of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications) is off and cannot be turned on: the browser has no Web Push.

settings.notifications.push.install.defaultMessage: iPhone と iPad では、このサイトをホーム画面に追加して、そこから開くとプッシュ通知を受け取れます。
settings.notifications.push.install.description: Why the Push notifications switch of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications) is off and cannot be turned on in Safari on an iPhone or iPad: Web Push works there only once the site is added to the Home Screen and opened from it. Home Screen is Apple's name.

settings.notifications.push.closed.defaultMessage: ブラウザの確認に答えないまま閉じられました。もう一度確認するには、オンにしてください。
settings.notifications.push.closed.description: Under the Push notifications switch of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications), after the reader turned it on and closed the browser's permission question without choosing: the switch went back to off. The same case as notifications.push_closed, for a switch.

settings.notifications.sound.description: The switch, in the section This device of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications), that turns the sound of new notifications on or off for the device the reader is using. Off until the reader turns it on.

settings.notifications.sound.about.defaultMessage: アプリを開いている間に通知が届くと、この端末で音を鳴らします。オンの間、鳴らす種類を下の「音」の列で選べます。
settings.notifications.sound.about.description: The line under the Notification sound switch of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications). The Sound column (settings.notifications.channel.sound) of the tables below it appears once the switch is on, with every kind off.

settings.notifications.sound.try.description: The button under the Notification sound switch of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications): it plays the notification sound once, so that the reader hears what it is.

settings.notifications.sound.blocked.defaultMessage: ブラウザが音を再生しませんでした。ブラウザの設定でこのサイトの音の再生を許可してから、もう一度試してください。
settings.notifications.sound.blocked.description: Under the Notification sound switch of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications), after the reader turned it on or pressed Play the sound and the browser played nothing.

settings.notifications.email_stopped.defaultMessage: あなたのアドレスへのメールを止めています
settings.notifications.email_stopped.description: The heading of the notice at the top of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications) while the server no longer sends email to the reader's address. A sentence without a full stop.

settings.notifications.email_stopped.abo.defaultMessage: {kind, select, hard_bounce {あなたのアドレスへのメールが届かなかったため、アドレスをもう一度確認するまで、通知を含むメールを送りません。} other {このサーバーからのメールが迷惑メールとして報告されたため、通知のメールを送っていません。もう一度受け取るには、このサーバーのモデレーターに問い合わせてください。}}
settings.notifications.email_stopped.abo.description: Under settings.notifications.email_stopped: why the server stopped, and after a complaint the only way back. kind is hard_bounce (an email to the address came back: the address does not exist or refuses email; every email stops until the reader verifies the address again, with the button under this line) or complaint (the recipient marked an email as spam; only notification emails stop, until a moderator lifts it).

settings.notifications.email_stopped.ver.description: The button of the notice settings.notifications.email_stopped after an email to the reader's address bounced: sends a new verification email, whose link shows the address works and lifts the stop.

settings.notifications.email_stopped.sen.defaultMessage: 送りました。メールのリンクを開くと、またメールが届くようになります。
settings.notifications.email_stopped.sen.description: Beside settings.notifications.email_stopped.verify once the server queued the verification email: what the reader does next.

settings.notifications.email_stopped.ver.defaultMessage: アドレスはすでに確認されています。このアドレスへのメールは再開されました。
settings.notifications.email_stopped.ver.description: On the notification settings page, in the place of the notice settings.notifications.email_stopped once the reader pressed Send the verification email (settings.notifications.email_stopped.verify) and the server answered that the address is verified already: no email was sent, the notice is gone, and the server sends email to the address again. A status that takes the focus the button left.

settings.notifications.email_stopped.wai.defaultMessage: {minutes, plural, =0 {確認のメールを求めた回数が多すぎます。しばらくしてからもう一度試してください。} other {確認のメールを求めた回数が多すぎます。# 分後にもう一度試してください。}}
settings.notifications.email_stopped.wai.description: Beside the button Send the verification email on the notification settings page when the server refused to send another one so soon; the same sentence as on the sign-up status page (server:auth.status.resend_rate_limited). minutes is how long the server asks the reader to wait, rounded up to whole minutes, or 0 when the server did not say.

settings.notifications.email_stopped.not.defaultMessage: メールを送れませんでした。もう一度試してください。
settings.notifications.email_stopped.not.description: Beside settings.notifications.email_stopped.verify when the server did not answer; the button beside it tries again.

settings.notifications.column.kind.description: The header of the first column of a table of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications), the column of the kinds' names, for assistive technology only.

settings.notifications.channel.in_app.description: A column header of the tables of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications), and the label under a checkbox on a phone: the notification shows in the app's notifications. Keep it very short: it stands in a column 4.5rem wide.

settings.notifications.channel.push.description: A column header of the tables of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications), and the label under a checkbox on a phone: the notification is sent to this device as a push notification. Keep it very short: it stands in a column 4.5rem wide.

settings.notifications.channel.email.description: A column header of the tables of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications), and the label under a checkbox on a phone: the notification is sent by email. Keep it very short: it stands in a column 4.5rem wide.

settings.notifications.channel.sound.description: A column header of the tables of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications), and the label under a checkbox on a phone: the notification plays the notification sound on this device while the app is open. Keep it very short: it stands in a column 4.5rem wide.

settings.notifications.all.description: The name of the first row of a table of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications): each of its checkboxes turns one channel on or off for every kind of the table at once.

settings.notifications.cell.description: The name of one checkbox of a table of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications), in the message that a change was not saved (settings.unsaved): kind is the row's name (settings.notifications.kind.*, or settings.notifications.all), channel the column's (settings.notifications.channel.*).

settings.notifications.reason.in_app_off.defaultMessage: 「アプリ内」がオフなので、ほかの方法でも届きません。
settings.notifications.reason.in_app_off.description: The line with a kind's name in a table of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications) while its In the app checkbox is off: why its other checkboxes are off and cannot be changed.

settings.notifications.reason.fixed.defaultMessage: {channels, select, both {アプリ内とメールには必ず届きます。} email {メールには必ず届きます。} other {アプリ内には必ず届きます。}}
settings.notifications.reason.fixed.description: The line with a kind's name in a table of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications): why some of its checkboxes are on and cannot be changed (the server sends these to everyone). channels is in_app, email, or both.

settings.notifications.kind.mention.description: A row of a table of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications): a kind of notification. Someone mentioned the reader in a post (notifications.kind.mention). A noun phrase without a full stop. The notification emails quote this name (server:mail.group.mention): keep the two the same.

settings.notifications.kind.follow.description: A row of a table of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications): a kind of notification. Someone followed the reader (notifications.kind.follow). A noun phrase without a full stop. The notification emails quote this name (server:mail.group.follow): keep the two the same.

settings.notifications.kind.follow_reque.description: A row of a table of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications): a kind of notification. Someone asked to follow the reader (notifications.kind.follow_request). A noun phrase without a full stop. The notification emails quote this name (server:mail.group.follow_request): keep the two the same.

settings.notifications.kind.follow_accep.defaultMessage: 承認されたフォローリクエスト
settings.notifications.kind.follow_accep.description: A row of a table of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications): a kind of notification. Someone accepted the reader's request to follow them (notifications.kind.follow_accepted). A noun phrase without a full stop. The notification emails quote this name (server:mail.group.follow_accepted): keep the two the same.

settings.notifications.kind.boost.description: A row of a table of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications): a kind of notification. Someone boosted a post of the reader (notifications.kind.boost). A noun phrase without a full stop. The notification emails quote this name (server:mail.group.boost): keep the two the same.

settings.notifications.kind.favourite.description: A row of a table of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications): a kind of notification. Someone favourited a post of the reader (notifications.kind.favourite). A noun phrase without a full stop. The notification emails quote this name (server:mail.group.favourite): keep the two the same.

settings.notifications.kind.reaction.description: A row of a table of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications): a kind of notification. Someone reacted to a post of the reader with an emoji (notifications.kind.reaction). A noun phrase without a full stop. The notification emails quote this name (server:mail.group.reaction): keep the two the same.

settings.notifications.kind.quote.description: A row of a table of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications): a kind of notification. Someone quoted a post of the reader (notifications.kind.quote). A noun phrase without a full stop. The notification emails quote this name (server:mail.group.quote): keep the two the same.

settings.notifications.kind.interaction_.defaultMessage: 返信・ブースト・引用の承認
settings.notifications.kind.interaction_.description: A row of a table of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications): a kind of notification. Someone asked to reply to, boost or quote a post of the reader, which waits for the reader's approval, or an author approved or declined the reader's own reply, boost or quote (notifications.kind.reply_request and the like). A noun phrase without a full stop.

settings.notifications.kind.poll_closed.description: A row of a table of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications): a kind of notification. A poll the reader took part in has ended (notifications.kind.poll_closed). A noun phrase without a full stop. The notification emails quote this name (server:mail.group.poll_closed): keep the two the same.

settings.notifications.kind.account_move.defaultMessage: フォロー中のアカウントの移転
settings.notifications.kind.account_move.description: A row of a table of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications): a kind of notification. An account the reader follows moved to another account (notifications.kind.account_moved). A noun phrase without a full stop. The notification emails quote this name (server:mail.group.account_moved): keep the two the same.

settings.notifications.kind.voice.description: A row of a table of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications): a kind of notification. Someone started a voice chat room, or invited the reader to one (notifications.kind.voice_room_started, voice_room_invited). A noun phrase without a full stop. The notification emails quote this name (server:mail.group.voice): keep the two the same.

settings.notifications.kind.event.description: A row of a table of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications): a kind of notification. An invitation to an event, a change of its date or place, a reminder before it starts (notifications.kind.event_invited and the like). A noun phrase without a full stop. The notification emails quote this name (server:mail.group.event): keep the two the same.

settings.notifications.kind.status.description: A row of a table of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications): a kind of notification. A new post of an account whose posts the reader asked to be notified of (notifications.kind.status). A noun phrase without a full stop.

settings.notifications.kind.admin_report.description: A row of a table of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications): a kind of notification. For moderators: a new report awaits them (notifications.kind.admin_report). A noun phrase without a full stop. The notification emails quote this name (server:mail.group.admin_report): keep the two the same.

settings.notifications.kind.admin_sign_u.description: A row of a table of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications): a kind of notification. For moderators: a new sign-up awaits approval (notifications.kind.admin_sign_up). A noun phrase without a full stop. The notification emails quote this name (server:mail.group.admin_sign_up): keep the two the same.

settings.notifications.kind.admin_appeal.description: A row of a table of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications): a kind of notification. For moderators: a new appeal of a moderation action awaits them (notifications.kind.admin_appeal). A noun phrase without a full stop. The notification emails quote this name (server:mail.group.admin_appeal): keep the two the same.

settings.notifications.kind.admin_webhoo.description: A row of a table of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications): a kind of notification. For administrators: the server turned one of its webhooks off after it kept failing (notifications.kind.admin_webhook_disabled). A noun phrase without a full stop. The notification emails quote this name (server:mail.group.admin_webhook_disabled): keep the two the same.

settings.notifications.kind.admin_hook_f.description: A row of a table of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications): a kind of notification. For administrators: an external review of posts keeps failing (notifications.kind.admin_hook_failing). A noun phrase without a full stop. The notification emails quote this name (server:mail.group.admin_hook_failing): keep the two the same.

settings.notifications.kind.admin_hook_a.defaultMessage: 拒否された投稿への異議申し立て
settings.notifications.kind.admin_hook_a.description: A row of a table of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications): a kind of notification. For moderators: an appeal of a post that an external review refused awaits them (notifications.kind.admin_hook_appeal). A noun phrase without a full stop. The notification emails quote this name (server:mail.group.admin_hook_appeal): keep the two the same.

settings.notifications.kind.admin_domain.defaultMessage: ブロックリストの購読の失敗
settings.notifications.kind.admin_domain.description: A row of a table of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications): a kind of notification. For administrators: a blocklist the server subscribes to keeps failing to load (notifications.kind.admin_domain_list_failing). A noun phrase without a full stop. The notification emails quote this name (server:mail.group.admin_domain_list_failing): keep the two the same.

settings.notifications.kind.admin_custom.defaultMessage: カスタム絵文字の申請
settings.notifications.kind.admin_custom.description: A row of a table of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications): a kind of notification. For administrators: a request for a custom emoji awaits review (notifications.kind.admin_custom_emoji_request). A noun phrase without a full stop. The notification emails quote this name (server:mail.group.admin_custom_emoji_request): keep the two the same.

settings.notifications.kind.admin_accoun.defaultMessage: 制限中のアカウントの移転
settings.notifications.kind.admin_accoun.description: A row of a table of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications): a kind of notification. For moderators: an account they limited moved to another account (notifications.kind.admin_account_moved). A noun phrase without a full stop. The notification emails quote this name (server:mail.group.admin_account_moved): keep the two the same.

settings.notifications.kind.admin_servic.description: A row of a table of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications): a kind of notification. For administrators: the announced closing date of the server has passed, and it is time to close it (notifications.kind.admin_service_closure_due). A noun phrase without a full stop. The notification emails quote this name (server:mail.group.admin_service_closure_due): keep the two the same.

settings.notifications.kind.admin_error_.defaultMessage: 新しいエラーと再発したエラー
settings.notifications.kind.admin_error_.description: A row of a table of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications): a kind of notification. For administrators: a new error of the server was reported, or a resolved one happened again (notifications.kind.admin_error_group_created and the like). A noun phrase without a full stop. The notification emails quote this name (server:mail.group.admin_error_group): keep the two the same.

settings.notifications.kind.moderation.defaultMessage: モデレーターからのお知らせ
settings.notifications.kind.moderation.description: A row of a table of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications): a kind of notification. The moderators' notices to the reader, the result of an appeal, the resolution of a report the reader filed (notifications.kind.moderation_notice and the like). A noun phrase without a full stop. The notification emails quote this name (server:mail.group.moderation): keep the two the same.

settings.notifications.kind.service_clos.description: A row of a table of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications): a kind of notification. The server announced that it will close, changed the date, or withdrew the closure (notifications.kind.service_closure_announced and the like). A noun phrase without a full stop.

settings.notifications.kind.supporter.description: A row of a table of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications): a kind of notification. A payment of the reader's supporter plan failed, or the plan ended (notifications.kind.supporter_payment_failed and the like). A noun phrase without a full stop.

settings.notifications.kind.announcement.description: A row of a table of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications): a kind of notification. An announcement of the server's administrators (notifications.kind.announcement). A noun phrase without a full stop.

settings.notifications.kind.auto_delete_.defaultMessage: 投稿の自動削除のお知らせ
settings.notifications.kind.auto_delete_.description: A row of a table of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications): a kind of notification. The server's limit on how long posts are kept will delete old posts of the reader (notifications.kind.auto_delete_limit). A noun phrase without a full stop. The notification emails quote this name (server:mail.group.auto_delete_limit): keep the two the same.

settings.notifications.kind.unpublished_.defaultMessage: 公開できなかった予約投稿
settings.notifications.kind.unpublished_.description: A row of a table of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications): a kind of notification. A post the reader scheduled could not be published at its time (notifications.kind.scheduled_status_failed). A noun phrase without a full stop.

settings.notifications.policy.defaultMessage: 知らないかもしれない人からの通知
settings.notifications.policy.description: A section heading of the notification settings page (settings.entry.notifications): for each kind of sender below it, what happens to their notifications.

settings.notifications.policy.actions.defaultMessage: それぞれの選択でどうなるか
settings.notifications.policy.actions.description: The name, for assistive technology, of the list under the heading Notifications from people you may not know that says what each of the three choices does: Accept, Hold back, Drop (settings.notifications.policy.action), each over its line (settings.notifications.policy.about.*).

settings.notifications.policy.about.acce.defaultMessage: 通知はいつもどおり届きます。
settings.notifications.policy.about.acce.description: The line under Accept in the list of what each choice does, under the heading Notifications from people you may not know.

settings.notifications.policy.about.filt.defaultMessage: 受け入れるか消すまで「保留中の通知」で待ちます。
settings.notifications.policy.about.filt.description: The line under Hold back in the list of what each choice does, under the heading Notifications from people you may not know. The quoted words are the name of the screen that lists them (notifications.held).

settings.notifications.policy.about.drop.defaultMessage: 通知は作られないので、あとから見ることもできません。
settings.notifications.policy.about.drop.description: The line under Drop in the list of what each choice does, under the heading Notifications from people you may not know.

settings.notifications.policy.action.defaultMessage: {action, select, accept {受け入れる} filter {保留する} other {破棄する}}
settings.notifications.policy.action.description: An option of each choice of the section settings.notifications.policy: what happens to the notifications of a kind of sender. action is accept (they arrive as usual), filter (they are held back, in the screen notifications.held) or drop (no notification is made).

settings.notifications.policy.not_follow.defaultMessage: あなたがフォローしていない人
settings.notifications.policy.not_follow.description: A choice of the section settings.notifications.policy: the notifications of accounts the reader does not follow.

settings.notifications.policy.not_follow.defaultMessage: あなたをフォローしていない人
settings.notifications.policy.not_follow.description: A choice of the section settings.notifications.policy: the notifications of accounts that do not follow the reader.

settings.notifications.policy.new_accoun.description: A choice of the section settings.notifications.policy: the notifications of accounts created recently.

settings.notifications.policy.new_accoun.defaultMessage: 作られてから 30 日たっていないアカウントです。
settings.notifications.policy.new_accoun.description: The line under the choice New accounts of the section settings.notifications.policy.

settings.notifications.policy.unsolicite.description: A choice of the section settings.notifications.policy: direct messages (posts whose audience is only the people they mention, the screen conversations.label) that the reader did not start. The app's words for them: direct messages, DM.

settings.notifications.policy.unsolicite.defaultMessage: あなたがその人に送った DM への返信ではない DM です。
settings.notifications.policy.unsolicite.description: The line under the choice Unrequested direct messages of the section settings.notifications.policy: a direct message is unrequested unless the reader sent that person one in the same exchange.

settings.notifications.policy.limited_ac.defaultMessage: モデレーターが制限したアカウント
settings.notifications.policy.limited_ac.description: A choice of the section settings.notifications.policy: the notifications of accounts that the server's moderators limited.

settings.notifications.policy.limited_ac.defaultMessage: このサーバーのモデレーターが、個別に、またはサーバーごと制限したアカウントです。フォローしている人にも当てはまります。
settings.notifications.policy.limited_ac.description: The line under the choice Accounts limited by the moderators of the section settings.notifications.policy. The other choices never apply to people the reader follows; this one does.

settings.relationships.list.defaultMessage: {list, select, blocked {ブロックしたアカウント} muted {ミュートしたアカウント} servers {ミュートしたサーバー} other {フォロー中のハッシュタグ}}
settings.relationships.list.description: The heading of a section of the settings' page Relationships, and the title of the page under it that holds the whole list. list is blocked (the accounts the reader blocks), muted (the accounts they mute), servers (the servers they mute) or hashtags (the hashtags they follow).

settings.relationships.empty.defaultMessage: {list, select, blocked {ブロックしているアカウントはありません。アカウントをブロックするには、そのプロフィールか投稿のメニューで「ブロック…」を選びます。} muted {ミュートしているアカウントはありません。アカウントをミュートするには、そのプロフィールか投稿のメニューで「ミュート」を選びます。} servers {ミュートしているサーバーはありません。サーバーをミュートするには、そのサーバーのアカウントのプロフィールか投稿のメニューで「サーバーをミュート」を選びます。} other {フォローしているハッシュタグはありません。ハッシュタグを開いて「フォロー」を選ぶと、その投稿がホームタイムラインに届きます。}}
settings.relationships.empty.description: In place of a list of the settings' page Relationships while it is empty: what it would hold, and how something comes to be in it, in the words of the menus of a profile and of a post (profile.block, profile.mute, profile.mute_server) and of a hashtag's page (timeline.tag_follow). list is as in settings.relationships.list.

settings.relationships.loading.defaultMessage: この一覧を読み込んでいます…
settings.relationships.loading.description: In place of a list of the settings' page Relationships while it is read from the server.

settings.relationships.failed_list.defaultMessage: この一覧を読み込めませんでした。
settings.relationships.failed_list.description: In place of a list of the settings' page Relationships when it could not be read (the network, the server); Try again follows it (settings.retry).

settings.relationships.failed_more.defaultMessage: この一覧の続きを読み込めませんでした。
settings.relationships.failed_more.description: Under a list of the settings' page Relationships, on the page that holds the whole list, when its next accounts could not be read; Try again follows it (settings.retry).

settings.relationships.more.description: The button under a list on the page that holds the whole of one list of Relationships (blocked accounts, muted accounts…), which loads the next ones.

settings.relationships.all.defaultMessage: {list, select, blocked {ブロックしたアカウントをすべて表示} muted {ミュートしたアカウントをすべて表示} servers {ミュートしたサーバーをすべて表示} other {フォロー中のハッシュタグをすべて表示}}
settings.relationships.all.description: The button under the first few rows of a list on the settings' page Relationships, where the list has more, which opens the page that holds the whole list. list is as in settings.relationships.list.

settings.relationships.unblock.description: The button at the end of an account's row in Blocked accounts (settings, Relationships) that stops blocking it at once, as Unblock of a profile's menu does.

settings.relationships.unmute.description: The button at the end of a row in Muted accounts or Muted servers (settings, Relationships) that stops muting the account or the server at once, as Unmute of a profile's menu does.

settings.relationships.unfollow.description: The button at the end of a hashtag's row in Followed hashtags (settings, Relationships) that stops following it at once: its posts no longer join the home timeline.

settings.relationships.done.defaultMessage: {action, select, unblock {{name} のブロックを解除しました。} unmute {{name} のミュートを解除しました。} unmute_server {サーバー {name} のミュートを解除しました。} other {{name} のフォローを解除しました。}}
settings.relationships.done.description: Under a list of the settings' page Relationships once the reader took a row out of it, where the focus goes, the row being gone. action is unblock, unmute (an account), unmute_server or unfollow (a hashtag); name is the account's handle (@user or @user@domain), the server's domain, or the hashtag with #.

settings.relationships.failed.defaultMessage: {action, select, unblock {{name} のブロックの解除を完了できませんでした。もう一度試してください。} unmute {{name} のミュートの解除を完了できませんでした。もう一度試してください。} unmute_server {サーバー {name} のミュートの解除を完了できませんでした。もう一度試してください。} other {{name} のフォローの解除を完了できませんでした。もう一度試してください。}}
settings.relationships.failed.description: Under a list of the settings' page Relationships when taking a row out of it got no answer from the server (the network); the row and its button stay, to press again. action and name are as in settings.relationships.done.

settings.relationships.muted.notificatio.description: A line under a muted account's name in Muted accounts (settings, Relationships): the mute hides the account's notifications as well as its posts. Without a full stop.

settings.relationships.muted.until.description: A line under a muted account's name in Muted accounts (settings, Relationships): when the mute ends by itself. date is a date and time (Nov 30, 2026, 9:00 PM). Without a full stop.

settings.relationships.count.defaultMessage: {list, select, blocked {{more, select, yes {{count, number} 件を超えるアカウント} other {{count, plural, other {# 件のアカウント}}}}} muted {{more, select, yes {{count, number} 件を超えるアカウント} other {{count, plural, other {# 件のアカウント}}}}} servers {{more, select, yes {{count, number} 件を超えるサーバー} other {{count, plural, other {# 件のサーバー}}}}} other {{more, select, yes {{count, number} 件を超えるハッシュタグ} other {{count, plural, other {# 件のハッシュタグ}}}}}}
settings.relationships.count.description: The heading of the one section of the page that holds the whole of one list of Relationships, whose title already names the list (settings.relationships.list): how many it holds, as a phrase (9 servers). more is yes while the server has more than it sent so far (count is then those read). list is as in settings.relationships.list.

settings.relationships.result.defaultMessage: {action, select, unblock {ブロックを解除しました} unmute {ミュートを解除しました} unmute_server {ミュートを解除しました} other {フォローを解除しました}}
settings.relationships.result.description: What a row of a list of Relationships says once the reader took it out (in place of its button and its facts), the row staying where it was until they leave the page: the account, server or hashtag stays named by the row. Without a full stop. action is as in settings.relationships.done.

settings.filters.list.description: The heading of the one section of the settings' page Keyword filters, the list of the reader's filters; the count follows it.

settings.filters.about.defaultMessage: それぞれ、適用する場所で、その言葉を含む投稿を畳むか隠します。
settings.filters.about.description: The line under the heading of the list of keyword filters (settings, Keyword filters), what a filter does.

settings.filters.full.defaultMessage: フィルタは上限の {max, number} 個に達しています。追加するには、どれかを削除してください。
settings.filters.full.description: The line under the heading of the list of keyword filters when the reader has as many as the server keeps, in place of settings.filters.about, and Add a filter is not offered; also the submit bar's sentence when the server refused a new filter for that reason. max is 100.

settings.filters.add.description: The primary button of the settings' page Keyword filters, at the end of the list's heading or under the sentence of an empty list, which opens the form of a new filter.

settings.filters.empty.defaultMessage: キーワードフィルタはありません。フィルタは、その言葉を含む投稿を、選んだ場所で畳むか隠します。
settings.filters.empty.description: In place of the list of keyword filters while the reader has none; Add a filter follows it.

settings.filters.place.defaultMessage: {context, select, home {ホームとリスト} notifications {通知} public {公開タイムライン} thread {スレッド} other {プロフィール}}
settings.filters.place.description: A place a keyword filter applies, inside settings.filters.where, so in lower case in en: home (the home timeline and the lists' timelines), notifications, public (the local, federated and hashtag timelines), thread (the posts before and after a post), account (a profile's posts).

settings.filters.expired.description: The state at the end of a filter's row in the list of keyword filters once its end has passed: it applies nowhere, and stays listed until deleted.

settings.filters.edit.title.defaultMessage: {kind, select, new {新しいフィルタ} other {フィルタを編集}}
settings.filters.edit.title.description: The title of the page of a keyword filter's form, under the settings' entry Keyword filters. kind is new (a filter being added) or edit (one that is there).

settings.filters.save.description: The button at the bottom of a keyword filter's form that saves the whole form: adds a new filter (new), or saves the changes of one that is there (edit); the page then goes back to the list.

settings.filters.save.failed.defaultMessage: フィルタを保存できませんでした。もう一度試してください。
settings.filters.save.failed.description: In the bar at the bottom of a keyword filter's form, beside Save, when the server did not take the form: what is wrong stands under the field it is about, when there is one.

settings.filters.save.refused.defaultMessage: 示した箇所を直してください。
settings.filters.save.refused.description: In the bar at the bottom of a keyword filter's form when the form or the server found something wrong with a field, which says what under that field.

settings.filters.section.filter.description: The heading of the first section of a keyword filter's form, which holds its name, what it does to a matching post, and when it ends.

settings.filters.name.description: The label of the field of a keyword filter's name.

settings.filters.name.hint.defaultMessage: 畳んだ投稿にこの名前が表示されます。
settings.filters.name.hint.description: The line under the label of a keyword filter's name: where the name shows ("Matches filter Spoilers" in place of a folded post).

settings.filters.name.missing.defaultMessage: フィルタの名前を入力してください。
settings.filters.name.missing.description: Under the field of a keyword filter's name when the reader pressed Add or Save with it empty.

settings.filters.name.over.defaultMessage: 名前は {max, number} 文字以内にしてください。
settings.filters.name.over.description: Under the field of a keyword filter's name when it is too long to save. max is 50.

settings.filters.name.rule.defaultMessage: 名前は 1 行で 1〜{max, number} 文字にしてください。タブなどの制御文字は使えません。
settings.filters.name.rule.description: Under the field of a keyword filter's name when the server refused it: the rule a name follows. max is 50.

settings.filters.words.description: The heading of the section of a keyword filter's form that lists its words and phrases; the count follows it.

settings.filters.words.about.defaultMessage: どれか 1 つを含む投稿が一致します。「単語全体」にすると、長い単語の一部には一致しません。
settings.filters.words.about.description: The line under the heading of a keyword filter's words: how they match, in one short sentence about Whole word (settings.filters.word.whole); the documentation explains the scripts that write words without spaces, where Whole word changes nothing.

settings.filters.words.add.description: The button at the end of the heading of a keyword filter's words, or under the sentence of an empty list, that adds a field for one more word or phrase.

settings.filters.words.empty.defaultMessage: まだ言葉がありません。一致させる言葉やフレーズを追加してください。
settings.filters.words.empty.description: In place of a keyword filter's words when the reader removed every one; Add a word follows it.

settings.filters.words.missing.defaultMessage: 言葉かフレーズを 1 つ以上追加してください。
settings.filters.words.missing.description: Under a keyword filter's words when the reader pressed Add or Save with none written.

settings.filters.words.left.defaultMessage: {count, plural, other {あと # 語追加できます。}}
settings.filters.words.left.description: Under a keyword filter's words when the filter or all the reader's filters come near the most words the server keeps: how many more can be added.

settings.filters.words.filter_full.defaultMessage: このフィルタの言葉は上限の {max, number} 語に達しています。追加するには、どれかを外してください。
settings.filters.words.filter_full.description: Under a keyword filter's words when the filter has as many as it can, and Add a word is disabled. max is 100.

settings.filters.words.all_full.defaultMessage: すべてのフィルタの言葉は、合わせて上限の {max, number} 語に達しています。追加するには、このフィルタかほかのフィルタから言葉を外してください。
settings.filters.words.all_full.description: Under a keyword filter's words when all the reader's filters have as many words as they can, and Add a word is disabled. max is 1,000.

settings.filters.words.too_many.defaultMessage: フィルタごとの言葉は {filter, number} 語まで、すべてのフィルタで合わせて {max, number} 語までです。先にいくつか外してください。
settings.filters.words.too_many.description: Under a keyword filter's words when the server refused the form because the words would pass one of its limits. filter is 100, max is 1,000.

settings.filters.word.description: The label of the field of one word of a keyword filter. n is its place in the list, from 1.

settings.filters.word.whole.description: The checkbox beside a word of a keyword filter: the word matches only where no letter or digit touches it, not inside a longer word.

settings.filters.word.remove.description: The button beside a word of a keyword filter that takes it out of the form.

settings.filters.word.remove_named.description: The name assistive technology reads of the button beside a word of a keyword filter (settings.filters.word.remove), which says which word it removes. n is the word's place, from 1.

settings.filters.word.over.defaultMessage: 言葉は {max, number} 文字以内にしてください。
settings.filters.word.over.description: Under the field of a word of a keyword filter when it is too long to save. max is 100.

settings.filters.word.rule.defaultMessage: 言葉は 1〜{max, number} 文字にしてください。タブなどの制御文字は使えません。
settings.filters.word.rule.description: Under the field of a word of a keyword filter when the server refused it: the rule a word follows. max is 100.

settings.filters.contexts.description: The heading of the section of a keyword filter's form that holds the places it applies in, a checkbox each (settings.filters.context).

settings.filters.context.defaultMessage: {context, select, home {ホームとリスト} notifications {通知} public {公開タイムライン} thread {スレッド} other {プロフィール}}
settings.filters.context.description: The checkbox of a place a keyword filter applies in. context is as in settings.filters.place.

settings.filters.contexts.missing.defaultMessage: 場所を 1 つ以上選んでください。
settings.filters.contexts.missing.description: Under the places of a keyword filter when the reader pressed Add or Save with none checked.

settings.filters.action.description: The label of the choice of what a keyword filter does to a post that holds one of its words (settings.filters.action.choice).

settings.filters.action.choice.defaultMessage: {action, select, warn {フィルタ名を残して畳む} other {完全に隠す}}
settings.filters.action.choice.description: An option of what a keyword filter does to a matching post: warn shows only the filter's name with Show in its place, hide leaves it out of the list.

settings.filters.ends.description: The label of the choice of when a keyword filter stops applying (settings.filters.ends.choice).

settings.filters.ends.choice.defaultMessage: {choice, select, never {なし} m30 {30 分後} h1 {1 時間後} h6 {6 時間後} h12 {12 時間後} d1 {1 日後} w1 {1 週間後} other {日時を指定}}
settings.filters.ends.choice.description: An option of when a keyword filter stops applying: never, after a duration counted from saving, or at a date and time the reader picks in a field that then shows (date).

settings.filters.ends.date.description: The label of the field of the date and time a keyword filter ends at, in the reader's time zone, shown when At a date and time is chosen.

settings.filters.ends.date_missing.defaultMessage: 日時を選んでください。
settings.filters.ends.date_missing.description: Under the end of a keyword filter when At a date and time is chosen and the field holds no date and time.

settings.filters.ends.date_past.defaultMessage: 今より後の日時を選んでください。
settings.filters.ends.date_past.description: Under the end of a keyword filter when the date and time chosen has passed.

settings.filters.ends.keep.defaultMessage: {state, select, ended {そのまま ({date}に終了)} other {そのまま ({date}まで)}}
settings.filters.ends.keep.description: The first option of when a keyword filter ends, for a filter that has an end: saving leaves the end as it is. state is ends or ended (the end has passed); date is the end, a date and time.

settings.filters.ends.ended.defaultMessage: このフィルタは{date}に終了し、どこにも適用されていません。新しい期限を選ぶと、再び有効になります。
settings.filters.ends.ended.description: The line under Ends in the form of a keyword filter whose end has passed. date is the end, a date and time.

settings.filters.delete.description: The heading of the last section of a keyword filter's form, for a filter that is there.

settings.filters.delete.about.defaultMessage: 言葉も一緒に削除され、このフィルタで畳んだり隠したりしていた投稿が再び表示されます。
settings.filters.delete.about.description: The line under the heading Delete filter: what deleting a keyword filter does.

settings.filters.delete.open.description: The button of the section Delete filter, which asks before deleting the keyword filter.

settings.filters.delete.title.defaultMessage: フィルタ「{name}」を削除しますか？
settings.filters.delete.title.description: The question of the confirmation before a keyword filter is deleted. name is the filter's name.

settings.filters.delete.text.defaultMessage: 言葉も一緒に削除されます。取り消せません。
settings.filters.delete.text.description: The text of the confirmation before a keyword filter is deleted.

settings.filters.delete.confirm.description: The button of the confirmation that deletes the keyword filter; the page then goes back to the list.

settings.filters.delete.cancel.description: The button of the confirmation that keeps the keyword filter.
